testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/my-account/review-history-validate-functionality.spec.ts > Webstore - My Account - Review History > validate review history functionality

scenario.summary: The signed-in registered user searches a product, opens its PDP and checks the name, writes and submits a review (best-effort when already reviewed), then checks Review History shows the review text and the product link and opens the product from it.
steps: Search sku, open the PDP, check the product heading equals productName
Write a review (reviewText, state) and submit; toast checked best-effort (re-run: already reviewed)
Open Review History; check heading, review text and product link
Open the reviewed product from history; check the product heading
stateChanges: A review of the product is submitted by the signed-in account (not again when it already reviewed it)
evidence: Title 'validate review history functionality' and the step labels match the flow

DECLARED ACCOUNT: the spec runs in the webstore-auth project (playwright.testim-webstore.config.ts, AUTH_SPECS my-account/**) signed in through the shared storageState written by testim-migrated/tests/auth.setup.ts, whose account is getMyAccountUser() (src/data/credentials.ts) = loadEnvironment().myAccountUser, username from env var MY_ACCOUNT_USERNAME (src/config/env.ts:80, set in the git-ignored .env.<env>, not in the test's JSON). Source 0 records that credential (masked). The test declares it with await testData.useExisting('user', getMyAccountUser().username) before its first step (the same account as the session)

Store MaxwellsHardware: webstore-auth uses testimEnv.web.baseUrl (WEB_BASE_URL, default webstore-z10-at), the store every migrated webstore spec runs on; the account's recorded records (orders, saved carts) are on PortalId 7 = MaxwellsHardware (tda rows)

sku z-4567890 and productName: profile FOUND active published SimpleProduct (inventory, storefront index 1). Need product PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK quantityUsed 1 (never added to cart), preferred source sku; sku -> product.sku, productName -> product.name

DOUBT: the test relies on the review existing after submit; if a resolved product was reviewed earlier by the account with another text, the Review History text check fails. No key requires a product not yet reviewed by the account

swap: data only through loadData (sku -> product.sku, productName -> product.name), no derived assertions (the product name is itself swapped; messages and heading are fixed UI text), no data value in the spec code, no other data file. The user need is only checked at pre-warm (the account is not declared or leased); to declare and lease it, use strategy migrate and add the useExisting line above
